name: fortios_heavy_semantic_drift
intended:
config system global
    set hostname "FortiGate-01"
    set timezone 04
    set admintimeout 30
end
config firewall address
    edit "web-server"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.10 255.255.255.255
        set comment "Production web server"
    next
    edit "db-server"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.20 255.255.255.255
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "web-server"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
    next
end
actual:
config system global
    set hostname "FortiGate-01"
    set admintimeout 30
    set timezone 04
end
config firewall address
    edit "db-server"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.20 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "web-server"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.10 255.255.255.255
        set comment "Production web server"
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "web-server"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
    next
end
